title: Terms of Care: Designing for Participation in Data Governance by Disability Communities
abstract: arXiv:2611.15720v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Improving disability representation in AI-generated media requires community-specific datasets, yet openly sharing such data can expose communities to misuse, decontextualization, and exploitation. We examine how disability communities can participate in dataset governance through context-sensitive licensing. Working with three disability advocacy organizations, we conducted semi-structured interviews, an educational webinar and modular license activity to promote community participation in data stewardship. Our findings show that governance in these high-context communities relies on organizational memory (especially situated harms); both formal authority and informal relational practices; communication; and resulting trust. translated_title: 关怀的条款：设计残障社群参与数据治理的机制
translated_abstract: 改善人工智能生成媒体中对残障群体的呈现需要社群专属的数据集，然而公开分享此类数据可能使社群面临滥用、去语境化和剥削的风险。我们研究了残障社群如何通过情境敏感的许可方式参与数据集治理。我们与三家残障倡导组织合作，开展了半结构化访谈、教育性网络研讨会以及模块化许可活动，以促进社群参与数据管理。我们的研究结果表明，这些高情境社群的治理依赖于组织记忆（尤其是具体情境中的伤害经历）、正式权威与非正式关系实践的结合、沟通，以及由此产生的信任。模块化许可活动使组织的数据选择更加易于理解并以价值观为导向，使社群能够调整知识共享条款，以表达允许的用途、特定行业的限制、保障措施等。
tldr: 该研究通过与三家残障倡导组织合作，提出情境敏感的模块化许可机制，使残障社群能够以价值观为导向参与数据集治理，在防范数据滥用风险的同时改善AI生成媒体中的残障呈现。
en_tdlr: This study proposes context-sensitive modular licensing as a mechanism for disability communities to participate in dataset governance, showing how values-led data stewardship can balance open sharing with protection against misuse, decontextualization, and exploitation.
